title: cooldown
summary: Cooldown.xml is shared machinery, not a surface of its own. Current Benilla retains CooldownFrame_SetTimer for native cooldown widgets and adds the reference-named CooldownFrameTemplate so third-party FrameXML addons inherit expected model geometry without unknown-template failures. MSUI does not host that addon/XML inheritance runtime; its desktop consumers share CooldownVisualLaw plus DrawCooldownSwipe/DrawCooldownFlash across action bars and bag item slots. The 2026-08-23 change is addon-framework compatibility, not a new desktop window or geometry delta.
